decision.reason: Only the parent knows when its outer timer starts. A helper-relative timeout cannot account for bash/source/Python startup before build_proof, and increasing a fixed reserve would only guess at board jitter.

exact_root_cause.detail: Upper API starts its 80 second wait around the outer bash process. O10 starts OuterProcessBudget only after bash setup, Python startup, argparse and entry into build_proof. The helper therefore computed deadline=helper_start+80 while the parent kill boundary was approximately helper_start+76.369. Its 4 second reserve began at helper elapsed 76 seconds, leaving only about 0.764 seconds before SIGINT instead of 4 seconds.
exact_root_cause.why_reserve_did_not_form_final: The final reserve was measured against a later helper-relative deadline. The critical localization path, not package inventory, reached that late reserve as the earlier parent timeout fired, so the parent preserved partial and wrote a TimeoutExpired fallback before O10 could assemble and atomically write final.
exact_root_cause.probe_order_finding: Moving ros2 pkg list behind localization/planner/path was valid but insufficient. The current run never reached package_checks; startup and critical probes consumed the parent budget first.
exact_root_cause.timeout_clamp_finding: run_bash clamps each probe to helper remaining minus reserve, but remaining was based on the wrong origin. A correct clamp formula cannot protect a deadline it does not know.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: --outer-process-timeout-s makes the helper and parent share one 80 second deadline
superseded_assumptions.superseded_by: The helper start-to-SIGINT interval was 76.764 seconds while the parent elapsed 80.395 seconds.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: A 4 second helper-relative final reserve is sufficient on the board
superseded_assumptions.superseded_by: Approximately 3.631 seconds of parent-counted startup occurred before the helper budget started, reducing the effective reserve to about 0.764 seconds.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: Keeping package inventory later is enough to guarantee natural final
superseded_assumptions.superseded_by: The interruption occurred after tf_source_probe and before tf_probe/package_checks; package inventory was never the active consumer.

helper_changes.behavior: OuterProcessBudget uses the earlier of parent absolute deadline and helper-relative deadline, so the new field can never enlarge the existing outer timeout. Explicit NaN or Inf fails closed as exhausted budget. Missing absolute deadline preserves legacy behavior.
helper_changes.readiness_semantics_preserved: Critical readiness remains first, package availability stays null when skipped, blocked outcome remains valid, and finalization remains fail closed with current_command=null.

parent_api_followup_contract.clock_domain: Same host and same boot CLOCK_MONOTONIC via Python time.monotonic(). Do not use epoch, time.time(), generated_at_ms, remote timestamps or a deadline computed on the PC proxy.
parent_api_followup_contract.launch_rule: Compute parent_deadline_monotonic_s=time.monotonic()+process_timeout_s immediately before the helper Popen path, include the absolute value in helper argv, and make the parent communicate wait consume only max(deadline-time.monotonic(), 0) after Popen so both sides terminate against the identical boundary.
parent_api_followup_contract.compatibility: Keep --outer-process-timeout-s and the existing HTTP request/response schema. The new helper CLI field is optional for direct/legacy callers; parent rollout adds it only to the internal helper argv. Do not increase process_timeout_s or the PC proxy timeout.
required_tests: Parent fake monotonic starts before Popen and advances through command construction/Popen; communicate receives remaining time, not a fresh full timeout.
helper argv contains relative timeout and the exact same absolute deadline used by the parent wait.
Natural blocked final with return code 2 bypasses SIGINT, partial read and wrapper failure artifact.
Expired/stale deadline fails closed without starting an unbounded helper probe.
Existing callers without the absolute field and existing HTTP schemas remain compatible.

verification.command: strict added-nonblank-line Chinese comment audit for O10 helper plus helper tests
verification.result: 38 Chinese comment lines / 168 added nonblank lines = 22.619%, strictly greater than 20%

remaining_risks: Upper API currently passes only the relative 80 second timeout, so deployed board behavior is not fixed until Robot Software produces and waits on the shared absolute deadline.

The 4 second final reserve still needs one future separately authorized current no-motion proof after parent integration; offline fake-clock coverage cannot prove board filesystem or scheduling latency.
Command process-group cleanup can consume part of reserve after a child timeout; the parent-aligned hostile integration test must preserve natural final under that path before any live retry.

next_step.instruction: Implement the parent producer/wait contract above, run the targeted test, then run the full Upper API plus O10 helper suites. Do not SSH or open another live proof window in this follow-up.
